capabilities.name: Source record validation
capabilities.description: Validates bounded source metadata, HTTPS URL syntax, access constraints, and review-state invariants.
limitations: Validation does not establish legal permission, source authenticity, URL safety, or source accuracy.

capabilities.name: Approved source metadata index
capabilities.description: Maintains a bounded in-memory catalog and filters to approved, unexpired sources by purpose and source type.
limitations: The index is process-local, in-memory, and not durable or distributed.

explicit_non_capabilities: Web crawling, scraping, downloading, or source collection
External API access or authenticated provider integration
Legal advice or automated license interpretation
Durable storage, distributed replication, or federation
